task.name: Inspect_gray-water_IBC
task.when: At shift start and every 2 hours during a Dominatrix shift

step.action: Inspect the IBC, seams, inlets, outlets, and hoses for a visible leak.
Inspect the playa under and around the IBC for moisture or a puddle.
Observe the gray-water level without opening the IBC.
Tell the Dominatrix the level reading.

passWhen.criterion: No leak, moisture, or puddle is visible.
The IBC is not visibly full.
The Dominatrix received the level reading.

problem.condition: A leak, puddle, or full IBC is present.
problem.response: Stop showers, dishwashing, and other gray-water-producing tasks. Tell the Dominatrix immediately.
